_meta.description: Stage 1 (Onboarding / Registered) for the universal Anaplan product Pre-Sales journey template. Mirrors the Delivery Stage 1 structure with persona-specific resource profile fields, support engagement model, and prerequisite journeys. Slots into the larger Pre-Sales template at stages[0].
_meta.persona_audience_note: Primary audience: partner pre-sales / solution consultant. Bar set high enough that internal Anaplan PSEs can use the same content. Independent of the corresponding Sales journey — Sales is NOT a prerequisite, since Sales and Pre-Sales are typically different people with different roles. Use of pre-built Anaplan demo environments + scripts + sample data is assumed; configuration scope is light (client data: orgs, hierarchies, products) and does NOT include model building.
structural_alignment_with_delivery: Same task spine: orientation → portal → profile → support engagement → confirm primary focus → conditional parent-journey → prereq verification
Same gate model and verification sources
Same _fixed flags on universal tasks; product-name templating identical
Resource profile field set diverges (pre-sales-specific fields) — captured as persona-specific spec, locked separately
Support engagement task is renamed to reflect the hybrid pre-sales engineering / Partner Success engagement model
Prerequisite journey list retains Anaplan Platform (PSEs need platform navigation for demo orchestration) and adds Connected Planning Pre-Sales Foundations
open_items_parked_for_later: Pre-sales resource profile field spec — to be locked as a separate work item (technical specializations, demo environments, prior accreditations, etc.)
Computed time per stage — to be wired in once Stage 2 and Stage 3 task lists are locked
Parent-journey conditional logic — needs parent-journey concept defined as its own structural layer
Prereq journey naming — 'Connected Planning Pre-Sales Foundations' is a placeholder pending Op Cmte decision
Prereq recency policy (Anaplan Overview / Platform / Pre-Sales Foundations staleness) — program-level decision

_note: Stage 1 is mostly fixed across all products within the Pre-Sales persona. Variable elements: confirm-primary-focus task title and primary-focus-confirmed gate description.
name: Registered
description: Partner pre-sales engineer confirms journey understanding, portal access, expanded pre-sales profile, support engagement model, primary focus area, parent-journey enrollment if applicable, and prerequisite journey completion before product-specific work begins.

tasks.title: Review {{PRODUCT_NAME}} Pre-Sales Journey roadmap & expectations
tasks.description: Walk through the 5 stages, computed time commitment per stage, the Expert outcome, and how multi-journey / parent-journey enrollment works. Sets expectations before any other work begins. Calls out the Stage 4 progressive 3-level customer-engagement model (shadow demo → co-deliver → solo deliver discovery + demo + light config with post-engagement review) so PSEs understand the customer-facing investment Stage 4 represents.

tasks.title: Complete pre-sales resource profile
tasks.description: Capture firm, pre-sales / solution-consulting practice, territory, region and language coverage, industries supported, technical specializations (modules, integrations, AI), demo environments / platforms familiar with, prior Anaplan PSE accreditations and badges, years in pre-sales, years on Anaplan, current utilization band, prior products supported / demoed, demo languages, and manager contact info (name, email, role). Profile is a living record — fields can be updated as the PSE progresses across journeys.
tasks._profile_field_spec_status: draft — to be locked as a separate work item; pre-sales-specific spec diverges from delivery-resource and sales-resource specs
_persona_field_divergence: ADDED for pre-sales: technical specializations, demo platforms / environments, demo languages, industries supported, prior products supported/demoed, years in pre-sales
REMOVED from delivery spec: prior delivery role, prior products delivered (replaced with pre-sales analogues)
RETAINED from delivery spec: firm, region/language, prior credentials, manager contact

tasks.title: Understand how to engage Anaplan pre-sales and partner support
tasks.description: Review the hybrid engagement model for pre-sales support — Anaplan PSE coordination for technical objections and competitive escalations, Partner Success for technical / platform questions, demo-platform support for environment issues, battlecard-and-content support, and how to use the Pre-Sales agent. Differs from the channel-sales engagement model used in Sales — PSEs route through both pre-sales engineering and Partner Success channels.

tasks.title: Confirm {{PRODUCT_NAME}} as primary focus for this journey
tasks.description: PSEs may hold multiple active focus declarations across concurrent journeys. This declaration scopes the current journey only, not the PSE's overall product coverage.

tasks._conditional: Required only if PSE is enrolled in a parent journey (e.g., a logical bundle such as Connected Financial Planning across IFP + FCR). Otherwise auto-skipped.
tasks.title: Confirm parent journey enrollment (if applicable)
tasks.description: If this journey is part of a parent journey, confirm enrollment so progression, gates, and Expert outcomes are tracked at the parent-journey level.

tasks._persona_specific_prereq: Pre-Sales retains 'Anaplan Platform' (PSEs need platform navigation to drive pre-built demo environments) and adds 'Connected Planning Pre-Sales Foundations' (discovery + demo orchestration + battlecard fundamentals).
tasks.title: Verify Anaplan Platform journey complete
Verify Connected Planning Pre-Sales Foundations journey complete

gates.description: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} Pre-Sales Journey roadmap reviewed and acknowledged
Pre-sales resource profile complete with Role = Pre-Sales and required fields populated. Manager info is OPTIONAL at this gate and REQUIRED at Stage 2 exit.
Pre-sales and partner support engagement model acknowledged
{{PRODUCT_NAME}} confirmed as primary focus for this journey
Parent journey enrollment confirmed (only required if PSE is enrolled in a parent journey)
Connected Planning Pre-Sales Foundations journey marked complete

_stage_exit_actions_note: No system-side actions on Stage 1 exit. Pre-built demo environments are pre-provisioned at the Anaplan account level; per-journey Stage 3 lab access (configure-and-demo lab) is provisioned within Stage 2, not on Stage 1 exit.
_estimated_effort_total_note: Computed from task estimates excluding zero-effort verification tasks. Same range as Delivery and Sales Stage 1 since the task spine is structurally identical.
